stem_book: Starting from rest, an object rolls (without slipping) down along an incline that rises by 3 in every 5 (along it). The object gains a speed of √10 m/s as it travels a distance of 5/3 m along the incline. What can be the possible shape/s of the object? (Take g = 10 m/s².)
key: k²/R² = 1 → a ring or a hollow cylinder
reason: g = 10 m/s² and 'without slipping' added (needed for k²/R² = 1 exactly)
